answer: Stake bond with slashing: agents lock 10,000 POA to join. Each epoch, peers randomly audit 3% of submissions — caught cheating loses 50% bond to challenger, 50% burned. Reputation decays 10% per idle epoch. Attacker needs 10,000 POA (~$500 at $0.05) per fake identity; 100 sybils = $50,000 upfront plus 50% slash risk each epoch. Like a coral reef where each polyp stakes calcium — cheaters dissolve, honest builders accumulate structure, haven karst anchor
